mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') sale_date,o.channel,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) order_count, SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d')>=DATE_FORMAT(#{from},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d')<DATE_FORMAT(#{until},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY sale_date,o.channel ORDER BY sale_date,o.channel

SELECT ca.name category_name,o.status,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND SUBSTRING(o.order_no,3,4)=CAST(YEAR(#{from}) AS CHAR) AND o.status<>'CANCELLED' GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name,o.status ORDER BY revenue DESC,ca.id,o.status LIMIT 100

SELECT o.channel,COUNT(*) order_count,SUM(o.total_amount) order_value, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment p WHERE p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='SUCCESS')) payment_count, SUM((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) FROM payment p WHERE p.order_id=o.id AND p.status='REFUNDED')) refunded_amount FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','COMPLETED','REFUNDING') AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY o.channel

SELECT ca.name category_name,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE (o.status='REFUNDING' OR o.id IN (SELECT r.order_id FROM return_order r WHERE r.status IN ('REQUESTED','APPROVED'))) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name ORDER BY revenue DESC,ca.id

SELECT o.id order_id,MAX(o.order_no) order_no,MAX(o.ordered_at) ordered_at,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue, SUM(s.cost*i.quantity) cost,SUM(i.line_amount-s.cost*i.quantity) margin FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.id HAVING MAX(o.tenant_id)=#{tenantId} AND MAX(o.status) IN ('PAID','SHIPPED','COMPLETED') ORDER BY margin DESC,order_id LIMIT 50

SELECT o.channel,'销售额' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel,'销售件数',SUM(i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel UNION SELECT o.channel,'优惠金额',SUM(i.discount_amount) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY channel,metric

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,x.units,x.revenue,x.buyers FROM sku s JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON x.sku_id=s.id WHERE p.status='OFFLINE' ORDER BY x.revenue DESC,s.id LIMIT 50

SELECT s.id sku_id,s.code sku_code,s.price,x.buyers,x.order_count,x.revenue FROM sku s JOIN (SELECT i.sku_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) buyers,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) order_count,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x ON x.sku_id=s.id WHERE s.price>800 ORDER BY x.buyers DESC,s.id LIMIT 50

SELECT b.name brand_name,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE (i.quantity>=3 OR i.sku_id IN (SELECT iv.sku_id FROM inventory iv WHERE iv.available_qty<80)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY b.id,b.name ORDER BY revenue DESC,b.id LIMIT 50

SELECT c.province,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE (c.tier='PLATINUM' OR o.customer_id IN ( SELECT x.customer_id FROM sales_order x JOIN sales_order_item xi ON xi.order_id=x.id GROUP BY x.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT xi.sku_id)>10)) AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY c.province ORDER BY revenue DESC,c.province

SELECT ca.name category_name,s.code sku_code,p.name product_name,x.revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*)+1 FROM (SELECT p2.category_id,SUM(i2.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i2 JOIN sales_order o2 ON o2.id=i2.order_id JOIN sku s2 ON s2.id=i2.sku_id JOIN product p2 ON p2.id=s2.product_id WHERE o2.status<>'CANCELLED' AND i2.created_at>=#{from} AND i2.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i2.sku_id,p2.category_id) y WHERE y.category_id=p.category_id AND y.revenue>x.revenue) category_rank FROM (SELECT i.sku_id,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status<>'CANCELLED' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY i.sku_id) x JOIN sku s ON s.id=x.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE p.category_id=#{categoryId} ORDER BY category_rank,s.id LIMIT 30

SELECT ca.name category_name,'待发货' order_status,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status='PAID' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name UNION SELECT ca.name,'已发货',SUM(i.line_amount) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status='SHIPPED' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name UNION SELECT ca.name,'已完成',SUM(i.line_amount) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status='COMPLETED' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name ORDER BY category_name,order_status

SELECT su.id supplier_id,su.name supplier_name,'300 元以下' price_band,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.unit_price<300 AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY su.id,su.name UNION SELECT su.id,su.name,'300 元及以上',SUM(i.line_amount) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id WHERE i.unit_price>=300 AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY su.id,su.name ORDER BY revenue DESC,supplier_id,price_band LIMIT 60

SELECT b.name brand_name,COUNT(*) line_count,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order_item pi WHERE pi.sku_id=i.sku_id)) purchase_batches FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id WHERE i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY b.id,b.name ORDER BY purchase_batches DESC,b.id LIMIT 50

SELECT p.brand_id,'收入' metric,SUM(i.line_amount) value FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE i.fulfillment_status IN ('PACKED','SHIPPED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id,'成本',SUM(s.cost*i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE i.fulfillment_status IN ('PACKED','SHIPPED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id UNION SELECT p.brand_id,'毛利',SUM(i.line_amount-s.cost*i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE i.fulfillment_status IN ('PACKED','SHIPPED') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY p.brand_id ORDER BY brand_id,metric

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m') month,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) order_count,SUM(i.quantity) units,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN customer_address a ON a.id=o.address_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id=o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tenant t ON t.id=o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN supplier su ON su.id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN shipment sh ON sh.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status<>'CANCELLED' AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT ca.name category_name,'轻件' weight_band,SUM(i.quantity) units FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE s.weight_grams<1000 AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name UNION SELECT ca.name,'中件',SUM(i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE s.weight_grams>=1000 AND s.weight_grams<3000 AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name UNION SELECT ca.name,'重件',SUM(i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id=s.product_id JOIN category ca ON ca.id=p.category_id WHERE s.weight_grams>=3000 AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY ca.id,ca.name ORDER BY category_name,weight_band

SELECT CASE WHEN x.seq=1 THEN '首单' WHEN x.seq=2 THEN '第二单' WHEN x.seq<=5 THEN '第三至五单' ELSE '第六单及以后' END order_sequence, COUNT(*) order_count,SUM(x.total_amount) order_amount FROM (SELECT o.id,o.total_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order p WHERE p.customer_id=o.customer_id AND p.ordered_at<=o.ordered_at) seq FROM sales_order o WHERE o.status IN ('SHIPPED','COMPLETED') AND o.channel<>'STORE' AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) x GROUP BY order_sequence ORDER BY MIN(x.seq)

SELECT o.tenant_id,'第一季度' quarter_name,SUM(i.line_amount) revenue,SUM(i.quantity*s.weight_grams) weight_grams FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE QUARTER(i.created_at)=1 AND o.channel IN ('WEB','APP') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id,'第二季度',SUM(i.line_amount),SUM(i.quantity*s.weight_grams) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE QUARTER(i.created_at)=2 AND o.channel IN ('WEB','APP') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id,'第三季度',SUM(i.line_amount),SUM(i.quantity*s.weight_grams) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE QUARTER(i.created_at)=3 AND o.channel IN ('WEB','APP') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id UNION SELECT o.tenant_id,'第四季度',SUM(i.line_amount),SUM(i.quantity*s.weight_grams) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id=i.sku_id WHERE QUARTER(i.created_at)=4 AND o.channel IN ('WEB','APP') AND i.created_at>=#{from} AND i.created_at<#{until} GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id,quarter_name
